title: Everyday Account
text: The Everyday Account is a synthetic example product with no monthly maintenance fee in this sample corpus. Standard overdraft and external transfer policies may apply; verify current terms through the bank's official channel.

title: Student Account
text: The Student Account is a synthetic example product for eligible students. Applicants may be asked for proof of current enrollment through an official channel. This corpus does not define real eligibility rules.

title: Dispute Support
text: For suspected unauthorized activity, promptly contact the official fraud or dispute team through an authenticated bank channel. Do not share passwords or one-time codes. This assistant cannot inspect or dispute transactions.

title: Budgeting Education
text: A simple educational budgeting example divides take-home income into needs, savings, and discretionary spending. This is general education, not individualized financial advice.

title: Savings Account Opening
text: Illustrative savings-account opening checklist: compare official product terms, review eligibility and fees, gather identification documents requested by the bank, and complete any application only through an authenticated official channel. This assistant cannot create an account or submit an application.

title: Current Account Opening
text: Illustrative current-account opening checklist: confirm the product is appropriate with the bank, review eligibility and fees, ask the bank which identity and business documents are required, and apply only through an authenticated official channel. This assistant cannot create an account or approve an application.

title: PPF Information
text: Public Provident Fund (PPF) details, eligibility, contribution limits, withdrawal rules, and rates depend on current official scheme rules and jurisdiction. Verify all current terms with the official government or bank source. This sample assistant does not open or service PPF accounts.

title: KYC Guidance
text: Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements vary by product and jurisdiction. Ask the bank for its current checklist and submit identity or address documents only through its authenticated official channel. Never send document images, passwords, or one-time codes to this assistant.

title: Address Change Guidance
text: To update a mailing address, use the bank's authenticated website, mobile app, or verified support channel and follow its identity-verification steps. This assistant cannot access or change customer records. Do not provide a full address or account credentials in chat.

title: Email Change Guidance
text: To update an email address, use the bank's authenticated website, mobile app, or verified support channel and follow its identity-verification steps. This assistant cannot access or change customer records. Do not provide account credentials or verification codes in chat.

title: Balance Inquiry Routing
text: Account balances are private, live customer data and are not available to this assistant. Check balances in the authenticated bank app or contact verified bank support. Never share account numbers, passwords, or one-time codes here.

title: Illustrative Fixed Deposit Rates
text: This sample corpus uses a synthetic fixed-deposit annual interest rate of 6.50% solely for calculator demonstrations. It is not a current bank offer or a recommendation. Confirm live rates, compounding conventions, taxes, penalties, and eligibility with the bank.

title: Illustrative Recurring Deposit Rates
text: This sample corpus uses a synthetic recurring-deposit annual interest rate of 6.25% solely for calculator demonstrations. It is not a current bank offer or a recommendation. Confirm live rates, deposit timing, compounding conventions, taxes, penalties, and eligibility with the bank.

title: Investment Education
text: Mutual funds and ETFs carry risk and can lose value. Broad asset-allocation concepts may be discussed for education, but this assistant does not select products or give personalized investment advice. Consult a qualified, appropriately licensed adviser for recommendations based on an individual's goals and risk profile.
